source_refs.note: Topic 2.9.1.1 Try-Except Blocks (PDF 60-61, printed 57-58). The book's first line prints 'Input a'.

blocks.text: In Python, the try block lets you test a block of code for errors, and the except block lets you handle errors if occur.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The first line, Input a, is not Python (SyntaxError). The number is read with a = int(input("Enter a number: ")).

items: The try block contains code that might cause an error.
The except block catches the ZeroDivisionError and handles it by printing a message.
